about: Taché is a rural municipality in southeastern Manitoba, east of Winnipeg along the Seine River and Trans-Canada corridor—not a city. Communities such as Lorette, Landmark, and Ste. Geneviève sit among Francophone and Métis farm country, and the RM marks Canada’s longitudinal centre. About 12,000 people live in Taché RM.
seoSummary: Southeastern Manitoba rural municipality of Lorette and Landmark—Seine River farm country and Canada’s longitudinal centre.
